summary: Full regression pass on the SEC-001/002/003 security-audit remediation + broad auth/instructor regression. 23/23 tests passed. Confirmed: (1) rotated admin password '<redacted-SEC-001>' logs in with valid JWT; old 'Admin123!' returns 401; Erin & Jamin credentials still work. (2) Seed non-restore guard is in place in services/startup.py::_seed_account (password_hash only set when missing). (3) /api/instructors?q=(a+)++$ returns 200 in <1s (regex escape works); normal search still matches Erin; dot metachar treated as literal (no false matches). (4) _demote_low_confidence_name_changes demotes BOTH name AND choreographer unless composite>=0.95 AND title_ratio>=0.85; other fields auto-apply at composite>=0.85. (5) Apple unlink parenthesised guard still present in routes/auth.py. (6) Broad regression clean: register/me/forgot/reset/logout + instructor list/follow/main-instructor.

routes/instructors.py line 122 uses re.escape() on `needle` — SEC-002 ReDoS closed. Also escapes city needle (line 126).

context_for_next_testing_agent: SEC-001/002/003 remediation is verified. If regression is re-run, reuse /app/backend/tests/test_sec_audit_regression.py. Note: BASE_URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). The suite creates ~2 disposable test_*@example.com accounts per full run.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found.
